narrative.executive_summary: LIVE scan across 11 missions reveals a systemic inventory control failure masking as medium-risk alerts, now the primary threat to revenue continuity. Automated reorder logic has failed across 69 products — flagging 21, 20, 15 and 13 SKUs for immediate replenishment yet recommending 0 units — while high-velocity SKUs including Oil (42 units), Biscuits (30), Mouse (28) and Sugar (23) accelerate toward stockout. Profitability is dangerously concentrated, with 'Mouse' alone driving ₹39,496.35 (29.49% margin) of ₹162,180.57 total profit on ₹505,881 sales, amplified by inconsistent sales baselines (₹505,881 vs ₹820,481) and fulfillment polarization in Mysuru (66 units, ₹177,753, 35% of revenue). Without immediate manual intervention, the platform faces cascading stockouts, lost sales, and margin erosion within the current replenishment cycle.

threat_vectors.description: Four missions flagged 69 products requiring immediate replenishment but system recommends 0 units, indicating complete logic failure. With 30 high-velocity SKUs active, imminent stockout risk for top movers Oil (42), Biscuits (30), and Mouse (28) threatens revenue continuity.

threat_vectors.name: Margin Concentration & Profit Fragility
threat_vectors.description: Profit heavily concentrated in single SKU 'Mouse' (₹39,496.35, 29.49% margin) within ₹162,180 total profit pool (32% blended margin). Discrepancy with secondary dataset (₹261,419 profit on ₹820,481 sales across 36 variants) signals reporting inconsistency and vulnerability to single-product demand shift.

threat_vectors.name: Fulfillment Polarization & Demand Volatility
threat_vectors.description: Sales polarized to Mysuru (66 units, ₹177,753) creating single-point fulfillment risk, while demand volatility spans 21 high-velocity products. Combined with 36-variant style collapse exposure and 2 critical low-stock items (Resistance Band 9 units), supply chain lacks resilience to localized disruption.

immediate_actions: HALT automated reordering and execute manual reorder calculation within 24 hours for all 69 flagged SKUs, prioritizing Oil (42 units), Biscuits (30), Mouse (28), and Sugar (23)
Conduct emergency physical inventory and Days-of-Cover audit for top 5 velocity SKUs against lead times, with same-day safety stock deployment for Resistance Band and Sandals
Reconcile profit/sales baseline discrepancy (₹505,881 vs ₹820,481) and stress-test margin impact if Mouse volume drops 20%, validating cost inputs for all 21 margin-analyzed items
Surge audit Mysuru fulfillment capacity handling 35% of revenue and resolve 4 phantom SKU referential integrity gaps to prevent order failure
monitoring_recommendations: Implement daily Days-of-Cover vs Lead Time dashboard for top 10 SKUs with automated alert when cover falls below 1.5x lead time
Establish weekly margin erosion and color-variant profitability tracking across 36 variants, flagging any SKU below 25% margin or >15% profit concentration
Deploy continuous location polarization and phantom SKU monitoring, alerting when any single location exceeds 30% of total units or sales
